verdict.rationale: Zulip is a team chat product, so AI-generated recaps of meetings and huddles are a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions calls, huddles, transcription or AI summaries. The bot framework is only a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: any documented AI meeting or huddle notes, recaps for missed calls, call transcription.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated notes and recaps from meetings and huddles I attended or missed
